description: This file defines the SideMenu class in a Selenium automation framework for the OrangeHRM application, providing methods to interact with the left side navigation menu.

classes.name: SideMenu
classes.description: Represents the left side menu navigation for the OrangeHRM application, with methods to open different sections by clicking menu items.

methods.name: menuItem
methods.description: Constructs a Selenium By locator for a menu item based on its name.

methods.name: openDashboard
methods.description: Clicks on the Dashboard menu item.

methods.name: openPim
methods.description: Clicks on the PIM menu item.

methods.name: openLeave
methods.description: Clicks on the Leave menu item.

methods.name: openRecruitment
methods.description: Clicks on the Recruitment menu item.

methods.name: openTime
methods.description: Clicks on the Time menu item.

methods.name: openAdmin
methods.description: Clicks on the Admin menu item.
